100,000 TL / 24 month benchmark. The official frontend maturity rule maps 100,000 TL to 24 months. The rate is obtained from LoanRateList and the payment plan from GetLoanPayBackPlan. The calculator page explicitly associates its financing tool with Taksitli Alisveris Kredisi. Allocation fee is stored separately and is not added to total_repayment.

Turkiye Emlak Katilim official calculator live snapshot for 100,000 TL / 24 months using bank-rate mode. CustomRate was omitted because the official form disables that field when the bank rate is used. profit_share_rate=ProfitRate; monthly_installment=first standard payment-plan Amount; total_repayment=TotalInstallmentAmount; allocation_fee=CommissionAmount; mortgage_fee=HypothecAmount; appraisal_fee=ExpertiseAmount; total_fees=TotalExpense. TotalCost and MonthlyConstRate were kept only in raw_output and were NOT normalized. Canonical product data was not modified.
